_about: Assistant-drafted adjudication proposals (Claude Code, claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-19). Not final labels: a human reviews every row in data/labels/round{1,2}/adjudication_worksheet.csv. Rule applied on top of guidelines v2: reject when the justification has three or more distinct factual errors, otherwise edit with a gold-grounded fix. Edit texts use only facts from the item's gold answer.
R1-Q0033:
Query: Which requirements are still pending before I can graduate as an MTech-CSE student in the Theory stream (thesis track)?
Justification: You still have a way to go: CS 621 (Ethics of AI) is missing, you need 4 credits from your own Theory basket, 16 more coursework credits, all 32 thesis credits and 8 elective credits, plus AI applications, physical education and Writing. That is 64 of the 82 credits still to go.

Justification says 'almost done' and '32 coursework credits needed' (gold: 64 of 82 remaining, coursework 16 to go); query adds 'documentation' (meaning_drift, lower priority). Two distinct errors, so edit.
R1-Q0109: Justification: Your core coursework and basket credits are complete: no compulsory or Systems core course is missing, and you have 8 credits in your own Systems basket and 8 in the other baskets (minimum 4 each). What remains is your project and total credit gaps.
Justification says 4 more own-basket credits are needed (gold: 8 earned, 0 to go); one error repeated across sentences, so edit (A2) rather than reject (A1).
R1-Q0120:
Query: Which requirements are still pending before I can graduate as an MTech-AI student in the coursework track, after 3 semesters?
Justification: You're almost there: you still need 4 credits from the other baskets (Systems or Theory), 4 more coursework credits and 12 more project credits, which is 32 of the 82 credits still to go. Your compulsory courses, AI/ML core, own basket and electives are complete.
Query narrows to 'courses and coursework' (v2 R4, meaning_drift outranks incomplete); justification states no gold facts (R1).
R1-Q0124: Justification: Your core coursework and basket credits are complete: no compulsory or AI/ML core course is missing, and you have 4 of 4 credits in your own AI/ML basket and 4 of 4 in the other baskets. What remains is outside these baskets: your coursework, elective, thesis and total credit gaps.
'A few more courses and credits' implies the asked baskets are incomplete; gold says 0 to go for both (v2 R2). Short justification, so edit.
R1-Q0161: Justification: You're on track. Your own AI/ML basket is complete (12 credits, minimum 4) and so are your electives (12 credits, minimum 8). You still need 4 credits from the other baskets, 12 more coursework credits (36 of 48 done) and 8 more project credits (8 of 16 done), so 36 of the 82 credits remain.
Says own basket needs 4 more (gold 0 to go) and 12 elective credits missing (gold 0 to go); two errors, so edit. Query is fine, so not meaning_drift.

Query says 'available' instead of 'left' (v2 R4); justification has the right direction (3 to go) but omits the open items (R1).
